description: Fetches a signed receipt as JSON: either a practitioner receipt by file name (the .json file name from a screening result, for a practitioner on your roster) or a monthly roster receipt (roster_id + period YYYY-MM, built from your latest complete run). Free (rate limited, not metered). A sandbox or non-production receipt is labelled as such or UNSIGNED and proves nothing; verify_receipt checks a receipt. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.

file.description: Practitioner receipt file name ending in .json.

roster_id.description: Roster id (from your account). Use with period.

name: get_receipt
title: Get a signed receipt
